about.title: About Sand Star Services
text: A general contracting company dedicated to efficient, quality craftsmanship — and to taking care of customers and team members alike.

Sand Star was created because the founders were tired of needing to micro-manage an untrustworthy general contractor — and tired of the way workers at "typical" contracting companies were treated, seen as ID tags to generate profit instead of human beings with dreams and talents.
So we formed Sand Star Services to take care of customers and team members. We're rooted in fairness and equity, with a joint focus on those around us who live, work, and play in our community.
